verdict.rationale: Epic's license page documents 'Access to the source code', and a community member confirms Unreal 'has source code included', so users can read the source. However, the probe shows access is EULA/account-gated: the GitHub repo returns Not Found without an authenticated, linked account. The source is therefore available under a proprietary license, not an open one, and the 'open license' half of the story is not met. Missing for 10: an open-source/OSI-style license, keyless public repository access for agents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
